mechanism_claims.claim_text: ZM-804/FITC-ZM-804 is supported as associating with bacterial cell membranes/cells in the confocal localization assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ZM-804 / FITC-labeled ZM-804 in bacterial indicator panel
mechanism_claims.limitations: FITC labeling reduces activity relative to unlabeled ZM-804, so this supports localization/membrane association rather than exact potency.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM/TEM evidence supports membrane surface disruption/permeabilization after ZM-804 treatment in representative Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ZM-804 against P. syringae pv. tomato DC3000 and C. michiganensis subsp. michiganensis

mechanism_claims.limitations: The evidence is morphological and qualitative; no pore model or receptor-specific target is promoted.
